name: tvr-skills-agent-advisory-council
description: An Agent Skill that runs a simulated advisory council (board, C-suite, customers, competitors, critics, regulators) on a decision, with fact-checked rounds and a recommendation that keeps the dissent

plugins.name: council
plugins.description: Convene an advisory board of stakeholder personas on a product, business, technical, policy or research decision: dossier, independent Round 1, fact-check addenda, tally, Round 2 vote, recommendation with dissent, risks and next steps. Free and MIT-licensed; if it saves you time: buymeacoffee.com/trespassvr
